subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: For malformed workspace `SKILL.md` files, should this issue close only after skipped-candidate diagnostics appear in normal `skills.status`/`skills list`/`skills check`/Web surfaces, or is a dedicated `openclaw skills lint` command enough for the first supported fix?
rationale: Current main has no diagnostic surface, while the open PR adds a lint command and some loader diagnostics but leaves the broader status/UI scope as a product decision.

options.title: Require shared status diagnostics
options.body: Make the loader/status report carry skipped-candidate failures and render them in normal CLI/Web inspection paths, with `skills lint` optional on top.

options.title: Accept lint-first MVP
options.body: Land a repaired `skills lint` command as the supported validation surface and leave list/check/Web warnings to a separate follow-up.

options.title: Defer diagnostics scope
options.body: Pause the implementation PR until maintainers settle parser-message redaction and which user surfaces should show local file failures.

recommendation.title: Require shared status diagnostics
recommendation.body: Make the loader/status report carry skipped-candidate failures and render them in normal CLI/Web inspection paths, with `skills lint` optional on top.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work is closest to the current skills loading path, and the decision affects the core skill-loading/status boundary.
